title: Getting started with the client portal
summary: Activate your invitation and find your project information
body:
HN Group Clients is available by invitation from the team.

Open your private invitation link and choose a password of at least 12 characters. Invitations expire after seven days and can be used once.

Once signed in, your dashboard shows the projects shared with your account. Open the attached documents to download files or invoices. If an update needs your approval, review the update and attached files before selecting Approve.

If you need access or a password reset, contact HN Group Support. Your customer account is separate from HN Group staff accounts.

title: Finding the right HN Group service
summary: A starting point for company and service information
body:
Use links.hngroup.org.uk to find HN Group companies and services. Search by name or filter the directory.

Use wiki.hngroup.org.uk for company information, news.hngroup.org.uk for published announcements, and status.hngroup.org.uk for operational updates.

For help with a service, visit support.hngroup.org.uk.
